# Fantasy Trade AI

> A free fantasy football trade analyzer for redraft leagues. Add the players on each side of a trade and get a plain-language verdict on whether it is fair, based on real market values from FantasyCalc.

Fantasy Trade AI runs entirely in the browser. There are no accounts, and no trade data is sent to a server. Settings and the current trade are saved in the visitor's own browser storage.

## What it does

- Compares two sides of a trade: the players you get and the players you give.
- Values players for your league settings: Standard, Half PPR or PPR scoring, 1 QB or Superflex, and league sizes from 8 to 16 teams.
- Returns one of five verdicts: fair trade, slightly or clearly in your favor, slightly or clearly against you, with a balance gauge.
- Suggests players who would bring a lopsided trade closer to even, and lets you add them in one click.
- Covers QB, RB, WR and TE in redraft formats. Dynasty values, draft picks, kickers and defenses are not included.

## How the verdict works

- Each player has a market trade value from FantasyCalc for the chosen league settings.
- Values on each side are added up, with extra players counting a little less (10% per additional player, down to a 50% floor), because a team can only start so many players.
- Sides within 5% of each other are called a fair trade. The depth adjustment is a rule of thumb, not a fitted model.

## Links

- [Fantasy Trade AI](https://fantasytradeai.com/): the trade analyzer
- [FantasyCalc](https://fantasycalc.com/): source of the player market values
- [Source code](https://github.com/StephensonCK/FantasyTradeAI): the project repository
